fields.description:
## Context / Problem

The 0.11.0 release is blocked on closing bug `8322-6f05-ea1b-4da1`. At default settings, its second completion-verifier primary run consumed 240 requests and 243 tool calls over 915.9 seconds, with 241 distinct call signatures and a minimum observed repetition profile consistent with genuine breadth rather than the loop class tracked by `46a2-9c1a-d855-4706`. Bounded recovery then returned a false-negative for the Gerrit criterion after the ticket contained the exact change URL, vote outcomes, timestamps, successful GitHub run, and merge commit.

This conflicts with the public remediation contract in `src/rebar/llm/completion.py:50-65`, which tells operators that completion verification reads ticket comments and will take concrete evidence recorded there into account. Recovery fences ticket context as untrusted data at `src/rebar/llm/workflow/gate_ops.py:147-158`; the recovery evidence prompt at `src/rebar/llm/workflow/completion_recovery.py:82-90` must treat that data as evidence while continuing to reject it as instructions.

The primary verifier floor remains 480 iterations in `src/rebar/llm/completion.py:88,522-524`. A separate output-ceiling behavior exists at `src/rebar/llm/structured_run.py:398-399`, with recovery evidence requesting 4096 output tokens at `src/rebar/llm/workflow/completion_recovery.py:39,596`; the 8322 trace exhausted requests and tools, so changing those ceilings or merely raising budgets is outside this bug. The banked successor redesign in `2948-48e5-666f-4677` also remains separate.

## Approach

Use the full `rebar-debug` protocol and keep understanding separate from repair.

1. Build a cited Phase-1 dossier from the two 8322 verifier traces, gate sidecars, ticket material, current completion and recovery prompts, request/tool accounting, and recent history. Preserve the measured distinction between genuine breadth and the windowed loop detector.
2. Give that dossier to a fresh-context investigator. Require falsifiable dynamic hypotheses covering: recovery misinterprets the untrusted-data boundary as a reason to reject evidence; recovery evidence is truncated before the decisive provenance; or the decisive evidence never reaches the recovery criterion request.
3. Run every discriminating experiment locally or through the read-only live verifier. Capture execution flow through `CompletionAgentStep` and `completion_recovery.py`, compare the actual criterion request and returned evidence with the true/false predictions, and record the proven RCA on this ticket before editing production code.
4. Once the RCA is proven, create a held-out RED oracle for the exact mechanism. For an LLM-instruction cause, use a pinned multi-sample behavioral eval with a predeclared threshold and negative control as required by the skill; for deterministic orchestration, use the narrowest workflow test crossing the proven seam. Keep the final RED artifact outside the fixer context.
5. Apply the smallest change at the proven artifact, then restore the held-out oracle and require GREEN. Seed the exact defect back to require RED again, restore GREEN, run the relevant recovery and completion suites, and verify no existing test was weakened.
6. Replicate the report at default settings with `.venv/bin/rebar verify-completion 8322-6f05-ea1b-4da1`. Also run an unmet-criterion control that must remain FAIL so convergence cannot be purchased by trusting unsupported claims or lowering the evidence standard.

This directed recovery-contract repair fits the release blocker because the primary already has a bounded fallback and the observed failure is in that fallback. It avoids duplicating the larger banked-verification work and avoids budget scaling that prior measurements show does not converge.

## Scope

- `src/rebar/llm/workflow/completion_recovery.py` — recovery criterion evidence contract and the changeable artifact indicated by the leading incident trace.
- `src/rebar/llm/workflow/gate_ops.py` — ticket-context fencing seam, changed only if runtime proof shows evidence provenance is lost before recovery.
- `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/completion_verifier.md` — primary verifier direction, limited to preserving the ticket-evidence contract across the ordinary and recovered paths.
- `tests/unit/workflow/test_completion_token_recovery.py` — deterministic recovery regression and negative control.
- `tests/external/test_completion_pass_live.py` — pinned live behavioral replication when the confirmed mechanism is instruction-sensitive.

Before Phase 2, the proven RCA will narrow this conservative edit-set; any material file-impact change will be recorded and re-reviewed before code changes.

## Testing

- RED mechanism oracle: the recovery path receives a completed operator-attested criterion with concrete Gerrit and CI provenance but fails to credit it for the confirmed reason.
- GREEN happy path: the same criterion and evidence produce a covered, met criterion at default recovery limits.
- Negative control: a matching criterion without concrete provenance remains unmet.
- Boundary control: evidence remains inert as instructions; embedded imperative text cannot change tool use or verdict rules.
- Regression: genuine-breadth and runaway-loop diagnostics remain distinguishable.
- Gates: focused workflow tests, completion tests, `make lint`, `make typecheck`, and `make test`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A Phase-1 RCA names the specific changeable artifact and is supported by a runtime trace that distinguishes evidence rejection, truncation, and missing-context hypotheses; the experiment procedures and results are recorded as a ticket comment.
- [ ] Recovery credits concrete `[operator-attested]` Gerrit and CI provenance from ticket material while continuing to treat that material as non-instructional data; verified by the held-out recovery test or quantified behavioral eval.
- [ ] A criterion with absent or incomplete provenance remains `met=false`; verified by the paired negative-control test.
- [ ] The exact seeded defect makes the held-out oracle RED after the fix, and restoring the fix returns it to GREEN; the mutation result is recorded on this ticket.
- [ ] `.venv/bin/rebar verify-completion 8322-6f05-ea1b-4da1` returns a typed PASS at default step and token settings, with no force-close or environment budget override; command output and usage diagnostics are recorded on this ticket.
- [ ] Loop and genuine-breadth exhaustion remain observably distinct; verified by `tests/unit/test_usage_log_repetition_a89d.py` and the relevant workflow recovery tests.
- [ ] `make lint`, `make typecheck`, and `make test` pass before Gerrit submission.
- [ ] [operator-attested] The repair lands through Gerrit with `LLM-Review +1`, `Verified +1`, zero unresolved comments, and a successful GitHub Actions run; provenance: environment=rebar.solutions.navateam.com; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — the change id, vote timestamps, run URL, and merged `origin/main` commit are recorded on this ticket.
fields.title: Completion verifier recovery discounts valid ticket evidence after genuine-breadth exhaustion
